scripts.setup: python3 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && pnpm --dir frontend install
scripts.setup:rag: uv venv rag/.venv --python 3.12 && uv pip install --python rag/.venv/bin/python --index-strategy unsafe-best-match -r rag/requirements.txt
scripts.setup:rostros: uv venv rostros/.venv --python 3.12 && uv pip install --python rostros/.venv/bin/python -r rostros/requirements.txt
